---
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    toc: false
    theme: flatly
params:
  data_file: "minnesota_destinations_coordinates.csv"
  home_city: "Wadena"
  segment_duration_ms: 500
  auto_start: true
  equator_circumference_miles: 24901
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

Sys.setenv(
  OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1",
  OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1",
  MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1"
)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)

required_packages <- c(
  "readr",
  "dplyr",
  "tidyr",
  "stringr",
  "leaflet",
  "htmlwidgets",
  "htmltools",
  "knitr"
)

missing_packages <- setdiff(required_packages, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Please install these packages before knitting:", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")))
}

invisible(
  lapply(
    required_packages,
    library,
    character.only = TRUE
  )
)
```

/* ---------- Rolling city reel ---------- */

}

.city-reel-item.reel-far {

}

.city-reel-item.reel-near {

}

/* Keep all five stops readable while preserving the oldest-to-current hierarchy. */
.city-reel-item:nth-child(1) { opacity: 0.45 !important; }
.city-reel-item:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0.60 !important; }
.city-reel-item:nth-child(3) { opacity: 0.72 !important; }
.city-reel-item:nth-child(4) { opacity: 0.84 !important; }

.city-reel-item.reel-current {

  font-size: 18px !important;
  font-weight: 900 !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

/* ---------- Progressive campaign calendar ---------- */
/*
   The calendar grows with the journey:
   - Current month starts large.
   - As each new month is reached, prior months stay visible.
   - All visible months shrink/reflow to fit the same calendar panel.
   - Calendar progression stops at today's date.
*/
.year-calendar {
  position: absolute !important;
  top: 140px !important;
  right: 10px !important;
  width: 410px !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 6px 7px 7px !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(78,45,126,0.10) !important;
  background: rgba(247,245,252,0.82) !important;
  z-index: 43 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

.year-calendar-title {
  display: block !important;
  color: var(--purple) !important;
  font-size: 9px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  text-align: left !important;
  margin: 0 0 4px 1px !important;
}

.year-calendar-grid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--calendar-cols, 4), minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
  grid-auto-rows: minmax(0, 1fr) !important;
  gap: var(--calendar-gap, 2px) !important;
  height: 230px !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
}

.mini-month {
  min-height: 0 !important;
  padding: var(--month-padding, 1px 2px) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(50,56,61,0.055) !important;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.55) !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
}

.mini-month-name {
  color: var(--purple) !important;
  font-size: var(--month-name-size, 6.5px) !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  line-height: 1 !important;
  margin-bottom: var(--month-name-gap, 2px) !important;
}

.mini-days {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr) !important;
  grid-template-rows: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
  grid-auto-rows: minmax(0, 1fr) !important;
  gap: var(--day-gap, 1px) !important;
  flex: 1 1 auto !important;
  min-height: 0 !important;
  align-items: stretch !important;
}

.mini-day {
  min-height: 0 !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  line-height: normal !important;
  font-size: var(--day-size, 4.1px) !important;
  color: #717171 !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;

}

.mini-day.has-event {

  font-weight: 700 !important;
}

.mini-day.active-day {
  background: var(--purple) !important;

  font-weight: 800 !important;
}

/* ---------- Final branded story card ---------- */
.story-ending {
  position: absolute !important;
  top: 46px !important;
  left: 0 !important;
  right: 0 !important;
  bottom: 0 !important;
  z-index: 9900 !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  padding: 42px !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 35% 42%,
      #EEE9FF 0%,
      #FFFFFF 48%,
      #F7F5FC 100%
    ) !important;
  color: var(--purple) !important;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 1200ms ease, visibility 0s linear 1200ms;
}
.story-ending.is-visible {
  opacity: 1 !important;
  visibility: visible !important;
  transition: opacity 1200ms ease !important;
}
.story-ending-line1 {
  color: var(--purple) !important;
  font-family: "League Spartan", Arial, sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;

}

  font-size: 29px !important;

  text-transform: uppercase !important;
}
.story-ending-line3 {

.story-ending-logo {

/* ---------- Story Scene 3: in-journey Earth milestone ---------- */
.earth-comparison-panel {
  transition: none !important;
  transform: none !important;
}

.earth-comparison-panel.is-milestone {
  transform: none !important;
  filter: none !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
  z-index: 1200 !important;
}

.story-journey-caption.is-earth-milestone {
  bottom: 0px !important;
}

.story-journey-caption.is-earth-milestone .story-journey-main {
  color: var(--purple) !important;
  font-size: 18px !important;
}

.story-journey-caption.is-earth-milestone .story-journey-small {
  color: var(--black) !important;
  font-size: 10px !important;
}

/* ---------- Story Scene 2: journey captions ---------- */
.story-journey-caption {
  position: absolute !important;
  z-index: 8600 !important;
  left: 0 !important;
  right: 0 !important;
  bottom: 10px !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  padding: 0 28px !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  color: var(--purple) !important;
  font-family: "Archivo Black", Arial Black, sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 15px !important;
  line-height: 1.08 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.005em !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(3px);
  transition:
    opacity 820ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 820ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
}

.story-journey-caption.is-visible {
  opacity: 1 !important;
  transform: translateY(0) !important;
}

.story-journey-caption.is-exiting {
  opacity: 0 !important;
  transform: translateY(3px) !important;
}

.story-journey-caption .story-journey-small {
  display: block !important;
  margin-top: 4px !important;

```{r prepare-data, include=FALSE}
data_file <- params$data_file
home_city <- stringr::str_trim(as.character(params$home_city))
if (!file.exists(data_file)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "The input CSV was not found: '",
      data_file,
      "'. Place the CSV in the same folder as this Rmd file, ",
      "or change params$data_file in the YAML header."
    )
  )
}

locations <- readr::read_csv(
  data_file,
  col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()),
  na = c("", "NA"),
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  trim_ws = TRUE
)

required_columns <- c(
  "sequence",
  "source_row",
  "stop_in_source_row",
  "date",
  "destination",
  "location_name",
  "latitude",
  "longitude",
  "County",
  "original_destination",
  "miles_counted"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(locations))

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "The CSV is missing required columns:",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

# Preserve the cleaned dataset order. Split multi-city records already use
# sequence and stop_in_source_row to define the intended order within a day.
locations <- locations |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sequence = as.integer(sequence),
    source_row = as.integer(source_row),
    stop_in_source_row = as.integer(stop_in_source_row),
    event_date = as.Date(date, format = "%m/%d/%Y"),
    location_name = stringr::str_squish(
      dplyr::coalesce(location_name, destination)
    ),
    latitude = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(latitude)),
    longitude = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(longitude)),
    County = stringr::str_squish(dplyr::coalesce(County, "")),
    zipcode = stringr::str_trim(dplyr::coalesce(zipcode, "")),
    destination = stringr::str_trim(destination),
    original_destination = stringr::str_trim(original_destination),
    miles_counted = suppressWarnings(
      readr::parse_double(
        miles_counted,
        na = c("", "NA")
      )
    ),
    notes = dplyr::coalesce(notes, ""),
    status = dplyr::coalesce(status, ""),
    is_future_event = !is.na(event_date) & event_date > Sys.Date()
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(event_date, sequence, stop_in_source_row)

# Daily reported mileage is calculated from miles_counted. That field counts
# each source-row mileage once, even when a multi-place record was split into
# multiple map points.
daily_mileage <- locations |>
  dplyr::filter(!is_future_event) |>
  dplyr::group_by(event_date) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    daily_reported_miles = dplyr::if_else(
      all(is.na(miles_counted)),
      NA_real_,
      sum(miles_counted, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Rows without usable latitude/longitude remain in the CSV but cannot be plotted.
unmapped_events <- locations |>
  dplyr::filter(
    is.na(latitude) |
      is.na(longitude)
  )

undated_events <- locations |>
  dplyr::filter(is.na(event_date))

event_input <- locations |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(event_date),
    !is.na(latitude),
    !is.na(longitude),
    event_date <= Sys.Date()
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    source_sequence = as.numeric(sequence),
    route_type = "event"
  )

event_geocoded <- event_input |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    lat = latitude,
    lng = longitude,
    zip_city = location_name,
    zip_state = "MN"
  )

unlocated_coordinate_rows <- event_geocoded |>
  dplyr::filter(
    is.na(lat) |
      is.na(lng)
  )

route_events <- event_geocoded |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(lat),
    !is.na(lng)
  )

home_coordinates <- locations |>
  dplyr::filter(
    stringr::str_to_lower(stringr::str_trim(location_name)) == "wadena",
    !is.na(latitude),
    !is.na(longitude)
  ) |>
  dplyr::slice(1)

if (nrow(home_coordinates) == 0) {
  stop(
    "Could not find usable Wadena latitude/longitude in the coordinate CSV."
  )
}

home_lat <- home_coordinates$latitude[[1]]
home_lng <- home_coordinates$longitude[[1]]
home_zip_city <- "Wadena"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# BUILD DAILY ROUTES WITH WADENA START + RETURN
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Each date is animated independently as:
# Wadena -> all mapped event stops for that date -> Wadena
#
# Wadena start/return points are generated automatically and are route
# points only. They are not real events and should not count as events.

daily_event_groups <- route_events |>
  dplyr::arrange(event_date, source_sequence, stop_in_source_row) |>
  dplyr::group_by(event_date) |>
  dplyr::group_split()

daily_routes <- lapply(
  daily_event_groups,
  function(day_events) {

    day_events <- day_events |>
      dplyr::arrange(source_sequence, stop_in_source_row) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        route_type = "event"
      )

    event_date_value <- day_events$event_date[[1]]

    # The generated Wadena start/return points inherit the day's planning
    # status so future trips are clearly labeled as planned, not completed.
    day_is_future <- all(day_events$is_future_event)

    first_sequence <- min(
      day_events$source_sequence,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    last_sequence <- max(
      day_events$source_sequence,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # START OF DAY: WADENA
    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # If the first actual event is already in Wadena, do not add a duplicate
    # home-departure point.

    if (stringr::str_to_lower(day_events$location_name[[1]]) !=
        stringr::str_to_lower(home_city)) {

      home_start <- tibble::tibble(
        sequence = NA_integer_,
        source_row = NA_integer_,
        stop_in_source_row = NA_integer_,
        event_date = event_date_value,
        zipcode = "",
        location_name = home_city,
        latitude = home_lat,
        longitude = home_lng,
        County = "Wadena",
        destination = home_city,
        original_destination = paste0("Start from ", home_city),
        notes = "Automatically generated start-of-day point.",
        status = "Generated route point",
        is_future_event = day_is_future,
        source_sequence = first_sequence - 0.5,
        route_type = "home_departure",
        day_stop = 0L,
        zip_city = home_zip_city,
        zip_state = "MN",
        lat = home_lat,
        lng = home_lng
      )

    } else {

      home_start <- day_events[0, ]
    }

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # END OF DAY: RETURN TO WADENA
    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # If the last actual event is already in Wadena, do not add a duplicate
    # return-home point.

    if (stringr::str_to_lower(dplyr::last(day_events$location_name)) !=
        stringr::str_to_lower(home_city)) {

      home_end <- tibble::tibble(
        sequence = NA_integer_,
        source_row = NA_integer_,
        stop_in_source_row = NA_integer_,
        event_date = event_date_value,
        zipcode = "",
        location_name = home_city,
        latitude = home_lat,
        longitude = home_lng,
        County = "Wadena",
        destination = home_city,
        original_destination = paste0("Return to ", home_city),
        notes = "Automatically generated end-of-day return point.",
        status = "Generated route point",
        is_future_event = day_is_future,
        source_sequence = last_sequence + 0.5,
        route_type = "home_return",
        day_stop = nrow(day_events) + 1L,
        zip_city = home_zip_city,
        zip_state = "MN",
        lat = home_lat,
        lng = home_lng
      )

    } else {

      home_end <- day_events[0, ]
    }

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # COMBINE THIS DAY'S ROUTE
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    dplyr::bind_rows(
      home_start,
      day_events,
      home_end
    ) |>
      dplyr::arrange(source_sequence)
  }
)

route <- dplyr::bind_rows(daily_routes) |>
  dplyr::arrange(event_date, source_sequence) |>
  dplyr::group_by(event_date) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    day_stop = dplyr::row_number()
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    step = dplyr::row_number(),

    display_name = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.na(destination) & destination != "",
      destination,
      location_name
    ),

    route_action = dplyr::case_when(
      route_type == "home_departure" ~ paste0("Start from ", home_city),
      route_type == "home_return" ~ paste0("Return to ", home_city),
      TRUE ~ "Event stop"
    ),

    # Only actual CSV event rows count as events.
    is_real_event = route_type == "event",

    # The animated route contains only events through today's date.
    is_covered_event = is_real_event,

    # Running event count excludes generated Wadena points.
    event_count_so_far = cumsum(is_covered_event),

    date_label = format(event_date, "%B %d, %Y"),

    popup_html = paste0(
      "<strong>Step ",
      step,
      " of ",
      dplyr::n(),
      "</strong><br>",
      htmltools::htmlEscape(display_name),
      "<br><em>",
      htmltools::htmlEscape(route_action),
      "</em><br>",
      htmltools::htmlEscape(date_label),
      dplyr::if_else(
        route_type == "event" &
          original_destination != display_name,
        paste0(
          "<br><small>Original entry: ",
          htmltools::htmlEscape(original_destination),
          "</small>"
        ),
        ""
      )
    )
  )

if (nrow(route) < 2) {
  stop(
    "At least two route points are required to animate a trip."
  )
}

# Calculate the straight-line length of each animated segment. A day's
# reported mileage is then distributed across all of that day's visible route
# segments in proportion to these lengths. This makes the counter rise during
# every outbound, between-stop, and return leg while preserving the exact
# reported daily total.
haversine_miles <- function(lat1, lng1, lat2, lng2) {
  earth_radius_miles <- 3958.7613
  degrees_to_radians <- pi / 180

  delta_lat <- (lat2 - lat1) * degrees_to_radians
  delta_lng <- (lng2 - lng1) * degrees_to_radians

  a <-
    sin(delta_lat / 2)^2 +
    cos(lat1 * degrees_to_radians) *
    cos(lat2 * degrees_to_radians) *
    sin(delta_lng / 2)^2

  2 * earth_radius_miles * asin(
    pmin(1, sqrt(a))
  )
}

route <- route |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    previous_lat = dplyr::lag(lat),
    previous_lng = dplyr::lag(lng),
    segment_distance_miles = dplyr::if_else(
      step == 1L,
      0,
      haversine_miles(
        previous_lat,
        previous_lng,
        lat,
        lng
      )
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    daily_mileage,
    by = "event_date"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(event_date) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    day_segment_distance = sum(
      segment_distance_miles,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    segment_miles = dplyr::case_when(
      step == 1L ~ 0,
      is.na(daily_reported_miles) ~ NA_real_,
      day_segment_distance > 0 ~
        daily_reported_miles *
        segment_distance_miles /
        day_segment_distance,
      daily_reported_miles == 0 ~ 0,
      dplyr::row_number() == 1L ~ daily_reported_miles,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cumulative_miles = cumsum(
      dplyr::coalesce(segment_miles, 0)
    ),

    # Earth comparison should continue through the full animated timeline.
    # Use reported mileage when available. If a later route segment has no
    # reported miles, fall back to the visible straight-line route distance.
    earth_segment_miles = dplyr::coalesce(
      segment_miles,
      segment_distance_miles,
      0
    ),
    earth_cumulative_miles = cumsum(
      dplyr::coalesce(earth_segment_miles, 0)
    ),

    mileage_available = !is.na(segment_miles),
    popup_html = paste0(
      popup_html,
      "<br><strong>Reported mileage for date: ",
      dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(daily_reported_miles),
        "Not available",
        paste0(
          format(
            round(daily_reported_miles, 1),
            big.mark = ",",
            trim = TRUE
          ),
          " mi"
        )
      ),
      "</strong>"
    )
  )

source_rows <- nrow(locations)
mapped_event_points <- sum(route$route_type == "event")
covered_event_points <- sum(route$is_covered_event)
planned_event_points <- 0L
animated_points <- nrow(route)
home_return_legs <- sum(route$route_type == "home_return")
skipped_na_rows <- nrow(unmapped_events)
skipped_undated_rows <- nrow(undated_events)
unlocated_count <- nrow(unlocated_coordinate_rows)
route_segments <- animated_points - 1L

mapped_route_dates <- unique(route$event_date)

animated_reported_miles <- daily_mileage |>
  dplyr::filter(event_date %in% mapped_route_dates) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    total = sum(daily_reported_miles, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  dplyr::pull(total)

total_reported_miles <- daily_mileage |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    total = sum(daily_reported_miles, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  dplyr::pull(total)

unanimated_reported_miles <- total_reported_miles - animated_reported_miles

equator_circumference_miles <- as.numeric(params$equator_circumference_miles)

if (
  is.na(equator_circumference_miles) ||
  equator_circumference_miles <= 0
) {
  stop(
    "params$equator_circumference_miles must be a positive number."
  )
}

equator_laps_at_finish <-
  animated_reported_miles / equator_circumference_miles

equator_complete_laps_at_finish <-
  floor(equator_laps_at_finish)

equator_next_lap_percent_at_finish <-
  (equator_laps_at_finish %% 1) * 100

days_without_reported_mileage <- daily_mileage |>
  dplyr::filter(
    event_date %in% mapped_route_dates,
    is.na(daily_reported_miles)
  ) |>
  nrow()

route_js <- route |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    step = as.integer(step),
    sequence = as.integer(sequence),
    source_row = as.integer(source_row),
    event_date = as.character(event_date),
    date_label = as.character(date_label),
    destination = as.character(display_name),
    original_destination = as.character(original_destination),
    county = as.character(County),
    zipcode = as.character(zipcode),
    route_type = as.character(route_type),
    route_action = as.character(route_action),
    is_real_event = as.logical(is_real_event),
    is_future_event = as.logical(is_future_event),
    is_covered_event = as.logical(is_covered_event),
    event_count_so_far = as.integer(event_count_so_far),
    daily_reported_miles = as.numeric(daily_reported_miles),
    segment_miles = as.numeric(segment_miles),
    cumulative_miles = as.numeric(cumulative_miles),
    earth_segment_miles = as.numeric(earth_segment_miles),
    earth_cumulative_miles = as.numeric(earth_cumulative_miles),
    mileage_available = as.logical(mileage_available),
    lat = as.numeric(lat),
    lng = as.numeric(lng),
    popup_html = as.character(popup_html)
  )
```

```{r animated-map}

# Lightweight county polygons from the maps package.
# This avoids sf while still allowing counties to fill purple as they are visited.
county_map <- maps::map(
  database = "county",
  regions = "minnesota",
  fill = TRUE,
  plot = FALSE
)

county_breaks <- c(0L, which(is.na(county_map$x)), length(county_map$x) + 1L)
county_segments <- lapply(
  seq_len(length(county_breaks) - 1L),
  function(i) {
    idx <- seq.int(county_breaks[[i]] + 1L, county_breaks[[i + 1L]] - 1L)
    if (length(idx) < 3L) return(NULL)
    list(
      county = stringr::str_to_title(
        stringr::str_replace(
          county_map$names[[i]],
          "^minnesota,",
          ""
        )
      ),
      lat = as.numeric(county_map$y[idx]),
      lng = as.numeric(county_map$x[idx])
    )
  }
)
county_segments <- county_segments[!vapply(county_segments, is.null, logical(1))]

# True geographic world polygons for the globe.
# maps::map('world') already supplies longitude/latitude coordinates, so the
# globe no longer reverse-engineers geography from a flattened SVG path.
world_map <- maps::map(
  database = "world",
  fill = TRUE,
  plot = FALSE
)

world_breaks <- c(0L, which(is.na(world_map$x)), length(world_map$x) + 1L)
world_segments <- lapply(
  seq_len(length(world_breaks) - 1L),
  function(i) {
    idx <- seq.int(world_breaks[[i]] + 1L, world_breaks[[i + 1L]] - 1L)
    if (length(idx) < 3L) return(NULL)
    list(
      lat = as.numeric(world_map$y[idx]),
      lng = as.numeric(world_map$x[idx])
    )
  }
)
world_segments <- world_segments[!vapply(world_segments, is.null, logical(1))]

animation_payload <- list(
  route = route_js,
  countyShapes = county_segments,
  worldShapes = world_segments,
  segmentDuration = as.numeric(params$segment_duration_ms),
  autoStart = isTRUE(params$auto_start),
  totalAnimatedMileage = as.numeric(animated_reported_miles),
  realEventCount = as.integer(covered_event_points),
  plannedEventCount = as.integer(planned_event_points),
  equatorCircumferenceMiles = as.numeric(equator_circumference_miles)
)

# Fixed Minnesota viewing bounds. The map is intentionally tile-free so the
# shared HTML does not depend on OpenStreetMap or any external basemap server.
minnesota_south <- 43.45
minnesota_west <- -97.28
minnesota_north <- 49.42
minnesota_east <- -89.45

# Lightweight Minnesota view:
# use the small 'maps' package only for Minnesota's outline.
# No sf geometry, CRS transforms, st_difference(), or inverse mask.
if (!requireNamespace("maps", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'maps' is required for the lightweight Minnesota outline.")
}

minnesota_outline <- maps::map(
  database = "state",
  regions = "minnesota",
  plot = FALSE,
  fill = FALSE
)

map <- leaflet::leaflet(
  width = "100%",
  options = leaflet::leafletOptions(
    preferCanvas = FALSE,
    minZoom = 4,
    zoomSnap = 0.25,
    zoomDelta = 0.25,
    maxZoom = 13
  ),
  height = 650
) |>
  leaflet::fitBounds(
    lng1 = minnesota_west,
    lat1 = minnesota_south,
    lng2 = minnesota_east,
    lat2 = minnesota_north
  ) |>
  leaflet::addPolylines(
    lng = minnesota_outline$x,
    lat = minnesota_outline$y,
    color = "#32383D",
    weight = 3.2,
    opacity = 0.95,
    options = leaflet::pathOptions(interactive = FALSE)
  )

map <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  map,
  jsCode = "
function(el, x, data) {
  var map = this;
  var route = HTMLWidgets.dataframeToD3(data.route);

  var storyIntroElement = document.getElementById('story-intro');
  var storyJourneyCaptionElement =
    document.getElementById('story-journey-caption');
  var storyEndingElement = document.getElementById('story-ending');
  var earthPanelElement = document.querySelector('.earth-comparison-panel');
  var earthFirstLapHaloElement = document.getElementById('earth-first-lap-halo');
  var earthFirstLapGlowElement = document.getElementById('earth-first-lap-glow');
  var earthFirstLapMilestoneShown = false;
  var earthPreviousMileageForMilestone = 0;

  function triggerEarthFirstLapMilestone() {
    if (!earthFirstLapHaloElement) return;

    earthFirstLapHaloElement.classList.remove('earth-first-lap-halo-active');
    void earthFirstLapHaloElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    earthFirstLapHaloElement.classList.add('earth-first-lap-halo-active');

    if (earthFirstLapGlowElement) {
      earthFirstLapGlowElement.classList.remove('earth-first-lap-glow-active');
      void earthFirstLapGlowElement.getBoundingClientRect();
      earthFirstLapGlowElement.classList.add('earth-first-lap-glow-active');
    }

    window.setTimeout(function() {
      if (earthFirstLapHaloElement) {
        earthFirstLapHaloElement.classList.remove('earth-first-lap-halo-active');
      }
      if (earthFirstLapGlowElement) {
        earthFirstLapGlowElement.classList.remove('earth-first-lap-glow-active');
      }
    }, 2800);
  }

  function updateEarthFirstLapMilestone(miles) {
    var currentMiles = Math.max(0, Number(miles || 0));
    var threshold = Number(equatorCircumferenceMiles || 24901);

    if (currentMiles < threshold &&
        earthPreviousMileageForMilestone >= threshold) {
      earthFirstLapMilestoneShown = false;
    }

    if (!earthFirstLapMilestoneShown &&
        earthPreviousMileageForMilestone < threshold &&
        currentMiles >= threshold) {
      earthFirstLapMilestoneShown = true;
      triggerEarthFirstLapMilestone();
    }

    earthPreviousMileageForMilestone = currentMiles;
  }

  if (!route || route.length < 2) {
    return;
  }

  var baseDuration = Math.max(100, Number(data.segmentDuration) || 650);

  // Playback speed controls the journey/story clock after the intro.
  // Default playback is 5x: fast enough to shorten the full journey while keeping the story readable.
  var speedMultiplier = 5;

  function scaledDelay(milliseconds) {
    return Math.max(1, Number(milliseconds || 0) / speedMultiplier);
  }

  function applyPlaybackSpeedToTransitions() {
    if (storyIntroElement) {
      storyIntroElement.style.transitionDuration = scaledDelay(850) + 'ms';
    }

    if (storyJourneyCaptionElement) {
      storyJourneyCaptionElement.style.transitionDuration = scaledDelay(820) + 'ms';
    }

    if (storyEndingElement) {
      storyEndingElement.style.transitionDuration = scaledDelay(1200) + 'ms';
    }
  }
  var maxPosition = route.length - 1;
  var currentPosition = 0;
  var playing = false;
  var animationFrame = null;
  var lastFrameTimestamp = null;
  var lastVisitedIndex = -1;
  var currentDisplayedMileage = 0;
  var currentMileagePoint = route[0];

  // Story intro is part of the SAME playback clock as the route.
  // No setTimeout is used for the opening scene.
  var introHoldDuration = 4500;
  var introElapsed = 0;
  var introLastTimestamp = null;
  var introActive = true;

  var milestoneMiles = Number(data.equatorCircumferenceMiles) || 24901;
  var distanceSetupMiles = milestoneMiles * 0.88;
  var distanceSetupRoutePosition = null;
  var distanceSetupShown = false;
  var milestoneShown = false;

  // Determine mobile mode BEFORE any vector layers/renderers are created.
  // JavaScript var declarations are hoisted, but assignments are not. In the
  // previous test isMobileLayout was assigned later, so it was undefined here
  // and the SVG renderer branch never ran.
  var isMobileLayout =
    window.matchMedia &&
    window.matchMedia('(max-width: 640px)').matches;

  // Renderer is selected at Leaflet map construction time in R.
  var completedLines = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
  var visitedPoints = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
  var movingLayer = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);


  var countyLayers = {};
  var countyShapes = data.countyShapes || [];

  function normalizeCountyName(value) {
    return String(value || '')
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/\bcounty\b/g, '')
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
  }

  countyShapes.forEach(function(shape) {
    var key = normalizeCountyName(shape.county);
    var coords = [];

    for (var c = 0; c < shape.lat.length; c += 1) {
      coords.push([Number(shape.lat[c]), Number(shape.lng[c])]);
    }

    var layer = L.polygon(coords, {
      color: '#D2CDD8',
      weight: 0.75,
      opacity: 0.95,
      fillColor: '#F7F5FC',
      fillOpacity: 0.34,
      interactive: false
    }).addTo(map);

    if (!countyLayers[key]) {
      countyLayers[key] = [];
    }
    countyLayers[key].push(layer);
  });





  var countyLabelLayers = {};

  // Anchor every county label to the center of the actual Leaflet polygon
  // registered under that county key. A zero-size divIcon prevents Leaflet's
  // default marker tooltipAnchor from shifting the text away from the center.
  Object.keys(countyLayers).forEach(function(key) {
    var layers = countyLayers[key] || [];
    if (!layers.length) return;

    var combinedBounds = null;

    layers.forEach(function(layer) {
      if (!layer || !layer.getBounds) return;

      var bounds = layer.getBounds();
      if (!bounds || !bounds.isValid()) return;

      if (combinedBounds === null) {
        combinedBounds = L.latLngBounds(
          bounds.getSouthWest(),
          bounds.getNorthEast()
        );
      } else {
        combinedBounds.extend(bounds);
      }
    });

    if (!combinedBounds || !combinedBounds.isValid()) return;

    var center = combinedBounds.getCenter();
    var southWest = combinedBounds.getSouthWest();
    var northEast = combinedBounds.getNorthEast();

    var latSpan = northEast.lat - southWest.lat;
    var lngSpan = northEast.lng - southWest.lng;
    var countyArea = latSpan * lngSpan;

    var matchingShape = countyShapes.find(function(shape) {
      return normalizeCountyName(shape.county) === key;
    });

    var labelText = matchingShape
      ? String(matchingShape.county || '').replace(/\bCounty\b/i, '').trim()
      : key;

    var useSmallLabel =
      countyArea < 0.20 ||
      lngSpan < 0.42 ||
      labelText.length > 13;

    countyLabelLayers[key] = L.marker(
      [center.lat, center.lng],
      {
        interactive: false,
        keyboard: false,
        opacity: 0,
        icon: L.divIcon({
          className: 'county-label-anchor',
          html: '',
          iconSize: [0, 0],
          iconAnchor: [0, 0],
          tooltipAnchor: [0, 0]
        })
      }
    ).addTo(map);

    countyLabelLayers[key].bindTooltip(
      labelText,
      {
        permanent: true,
        direction: 'center',
        className:
          'county-name-label' +
          (useSmallLabel ? ' county-name-small' : ''),
        opacity: 0,
        offset: [0, 0]
      }
    ).openTooltip();
  });


  function updateCountyHighlights(wholeIndex) {
    var visited = {};
    var lastVisitIndex = {};
    var currentCountyKey = '';

    /* Track every visited county and the most recent route position for it. */
    for (var i = 0; i <= wholeIndex; i += 1) {
      var p = route[i];
      if (
        p &&
        p.route_type === 'event' &&
        !p.is_future_event &&
        p.county
      ) {
        var countyKey = normalizeCountyName(p.county);
        visited[countyKey] = true;
        lastVisitIndex[countyKey] = i;
      }
    }

    /* Use the latest real event county as the current county. */
    for (var ci = wholeIndex; ci >= 0; ci -= 1) {
      var cp = route[ci];
      if (
        cp &&
        cp.route_type === 'event' &&
        !cp.is_future_event &&
        cp.county
      ) {
        currentCountyKey = normalizeCountyName(cp.county);
        break;
      }
    }

    /* The five most recently visited unique counties stay easier to read. */
    var recentCountyKeys = Object.keys(lastVisitIndex)
      .sort(function(a, b) { return lastVisitIndex[b] - lastVisitIndex[a]; })
      .filter(function(key) { return key !== currentCountyKey; })
      .slice(0, 5);
    var recentLookup = {};
    recentCountyKeys.forEach(function(key) { recentLookup[key] = true; });

    Object.keys(countyLayers).forEach(function(key) {
      countyLayers[key].forEach(function(layer) {
        var isVisited = visited[key] === true;
        layer.setStyle({
          color: isVisited ? '#4E2D7E' : '#D2CDD8',
          weight: isVisited ? 1.1 : 0.75,
          opacity: isVisited ? 1 : 0.95,
          fillColor: isVisited ? '#4E2D7E' : '#F7F5FC',
          fillOpacity: isVisited ? 0.72 : 0.34
        });
      });
    });

    var visibleLabelCandidates = [];

    Object.keys(countyLabelLayers).forEach(function(key) {
      var marker = countyLabelLayers[key];
      var tooltip = marker.getTooltip();
      if (!tooltip) return;

      var isVisited = visited[key] === true;
      var el = tooltip.getElement();

      if (el) {
        el.classList.remove('county-label-current', 'county-label-recent', 'county-label-older');
      }

      if (!isVisited) {
        tooltip.setOpacity(0);
        return;
      }

      var priority = 1;
      var targetOpacity = 0.58;

      if (key === currentCountyKey) {
        priority = 3;
        targetOpacity = 1;
        if (el) el.classList.add('county-label-current');
      } else if (recentLookup[key]) {
        priority = 2;
        targetOpacity = 0.84;
        if (el) el.classList.add('county-label-recent');
      } else {
        if (el) el.classList.add('county-label-older');
      }

      tooltip.setOpacity(targetOpacity);
      visibleLabelCandidates.push({
        key: key,
        tooltip: tooltip,
        element: el,
        priority: priority,
        lastVisit: lastVisitIndex[key] || -1,
        opacity: targetOpacity
      });
    });

    /*
      Collision suppression runs after Leaflet has positioned the labels.
      Higher-priority labels win: current county, then recent counties,
      then older visited counties. Older labels disappear only when they
      would visually collide with a more useful label.
    */
    window.requestAnimationFrame(function() {
      var acceptedRects = [];

      visibleLabelCandidates.sort(function(a, b) {
        if (b.priority !== a.priority) return b.priority - a.priority;
        return b.lastVisit - a.lastVisit;
      });

      visibleLabelCandidates.forEach(function(item) {
        var el = item.element || item.tooltip.getElement();
        if (!el) return;

        var rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        var pad = item.priority === 3 ? 2 : 4;
        var paddedRect = {
          left: rect.left - pad,
          right: rect.right + pad,
          top: rect.top - pad,
          bottom: rect.bottom + pad
        };

        var collides = acceptedRects.some(function(other) {
          return !(
            paddedRect.right < other.left ||
            paddedRect.left > other.right ||
            paddedRect.bottom < other.top ||
            paddedRect.top > other.bottom
          );
        });

        /* Never suppress the current county label. */
        if (collides && item.priority < 3) {
          item.tooltip.setOpacity(0);
        } else {
          item.tooltip.setOpacity(item.opacity);
          acceptedRects.push(paddedRect);
        }
      });
    });
  }

  function parseIsoDate(value) {
    var parts = String(value || '').split('-');
    if (parts.length !== 3) return null;
    return new Date(
      Number(parts[0]),
      Number(parts[1]) - 1,
      Number(parts[2])
    );
  }

  function renderYearCalendar(activePoint) {
    if (!yearCalendarElement || !activePoint) return;

    var activeDate = parseIsoDate(activePoint.event_date);
    if (!activeDate) return;

    // Stop calendar growth at the viewer's current local date.
    var now = new Date();
    var today = new Date(
      now.getFullYear(),
      now.getMonth(),
      now.getDate()
    );

    function toIsoLocal(d) {
      return (
        d.getFullYear() + '-' +
        String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' +
        String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
      );
    }

    var effectiveDate =
      activeDate > today
        ? today
        : activeDate;

    var effectiveIso = toIsoLocal(effectiveDate);

    // Reveal event dates only up to the animation's current effective date.
    var eventDates = {};

    route.forEach(function(p) {
      if (
        p.route_type === 'event' &&
        p.event_date &&
        p.event_date <= effectiveIso
      ) {
        eventDates[p.event_date] = true;
      }
    });

    var monthNames = [
      'Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun',
      'Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'
    ];

    var firstRouteDate = null;

    for (var r = 0; r < route.length; r += 1) {
      if (!route[r].event_date) continue;

      var candidateDate = parseIsoDate(route[r].event_date);
      if (!candidateDate) continue;

      if (!firstRouteDate || candidateDate < firstRouteDate) {
        firstRouteDate = candidateDate;
      }
    }

    if (!firstRouteDate) return;

    var firstMonth = new Date(
      firstRouteDate.getFullYear(),
      firstRouteDate.getMonth(),
      1
    );

    var visibleThroughMonth = new Date(
      effectiveDate.getFullYear(),
      effectiveDate.getMonth(),
      1
    );

    if (visibleThroughMonth < firstMonth) {
      visibleThroughMonth = firstMonth;
    }

    // Count the visible months and progressively shrink/reflow them
    // while keeping the calendar panel itself the same size.
    var monthCount =
      (visibleThroughMonth.getFullYear() - firstMonth.getFullYear()) * 12 +
      (visibleThroughMonth.getMonth() - firstMonth.getMonth()) + 1;

    var cols = 1;
    var monthNameSize = 18;
    var daySize = 15;
    var dayHeight = 27;
    var gap = 4;
    var dayGap = 2;
    var nameGap = 8;
    var monthPadding = '10px 12px';

    if (monthCount === 1) {
      // Keep the default single-month layout so the first month
      // uses the full calendar panel.
    } else if (monthCount === 2) {
      cols = 2;
      monthNameSize = 13;
      daySize = 9;
      dayHeight = 18;
      gap = 4;
      dayGap = 1.5;
      nameGap = 5;
      monthPadding = '7px 8px';
    } else if (monthCount <= 4) {
      cols = 2;
      monthNameSize = 10;
      daySize = 7;
      dayHeight = 13;
      gap = 3;
      dayGap = 1;
      nameGap = 3;
      monthPadding = '4px 5px';
    } else if (monthCount <= 6) {
      cols = 3;
      monthNameSize = 8;
      daySize = 5.5;
      dayHeight = 9;
      gap = 3;
      dayGap = 1;
      nameGap = 2;
      monthPadding = '3px';
    } else if (monthCount <= 9) {
      cols = 3;
      monthNameSize = 7;
      daySize = 4.7;
      dayHeight = 7;
      gap = 2;
      dayGap = 1;
      nameGap = 2;
      monthPadding = '2px';
    } else if (monthCount <= 12) {
      cols = 4;
      monthNameSize = 6.7;
      daySize = 4.3;
      dayHeight = 6;
      gap = 2;
      dayGap = 1;
      nameGap = 2;
      monthPadding = '2px';
    } else {
      cols = 4;
      monthNameSize = 6.2;
      daySize = 3.9;
      dayHeight = 5.1;
      gap = 2;
      dayGap = 1;
      nameGap = 1;
      monthPadding = '1px 2px';
    }

    var mobileCalendarCols = cols;
    if (window.matchMedia &&
        window.matchMedia('(max-width: 640px)').matches) {
      mobileCalendarCols = Math.min(cols, 3);
    }

    yearCalendarElement.style.setProperty('--calendar-cols', cols);
    yearCalendarElement.style.setProperty('--mobile-calendar-cols', mobileCalendarCols);
    yearCalendarElement.style.setProperty('--calendar-gap', gap + 'px');
    yearCalendarElement.style.setProperty('--month-name-size', monthNameSize + 'px');
    yearCalendarElement.style.setProperty('--day-size', daySize + 'px');
    yearCalendarElement.style.setProperty('--day-height', dayHeight + 'px');
    yearCalendarElement.style.setProperty('--day-gap', dayGap + 'px');
    yearCalendarElement.style.setProperty('--month-name-gap', nameGap + 'px');
    yearCalendarElement.style.setProperty('--month-padding', monthPadding);

    var html = '';
    var cursor = new Date(
      firstMonth.getFullYear(),
      firstMonth.getMonth(),
      1
    );

    while (cursor <= visibleThroughMonth) {
      var year = cursor.getFullYear();
      var month = cursor.getMonth();
      var first = new Date(year, month, 1);
      var daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();

      html += '<div class=\"mini-month\">';
      html +=
        '<div class=\"mini-month-name\">' +
        monthNames[month] + ' ' + year +
        '</div>';
      html += '<div class=\"mini-days\">';

      for (
        var blank = 0;
        blank < first.getDay();
        blank += 1
      ) {
        html += '<span class=\"mini-day\"></span>';
      }

      for (var day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day += 1) {
        var iso =
          year + '-' +
          String(month + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' +
          String(day).padStart(2, '0');

        var classes = 'mini-day';

        if (eventDates[iso]) {
          classes += ' has-event';
        }

        if (iso === effectiveIso) {
          classes += ' active-day';
        }

        html +=
          '<span class=\"' +
          classes +
          '\">' +
          day +
          '</span>';
      }

      html += '</div></div>';

      cursor = new Date(year, month + 1, 1);
    }

    yearCalendarElement.innerHTML = html;
  }

  function cityReelEscape(value) {
    return String(value || '')
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
      .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
      .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
      .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
  }

  function updateCityReel(routeIndex) {
    if (!cityReelElement) return;

    var reachedCities = [];
    var lastCityKey = '';

    for (var i = 0; i <= routeIndex && i < route.length; i += 1) {
      var r = route[i];
      if (!r || !r.is_real_event) continue;

      var city = String(r.destination || '').trim();
      if (!city) continue;

      var cityKey = city.toLowerCase();
      if (cityKey === lastCityKey) continue;

      reachedCities.push(city);
      lastCityKey = cityKey;
    }

    if (!reachedCities.length) {
      cityReelElement.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    var recent = reachedCities.slice(-5);

    // Chronological reel: oldest at the top, current/newest at the bottom.
    // Pad the top while fewer than five real event cities have been reached.
    var slots = ['', '', '', '', ''];
    var startSlot = 5 - recent.length;
    for (var k = 0; k < recent.length; k += 1) {
      slots[startSlot + k] = recent[k];
    }

    var classes = [
      'reel-far',
      'reel-far',
      'reel-near',
      'reel-near',
      'reel-current'
    ];

    var html = '';
    for (var j = 0; j < slots.length; j += 1) {
      if (!slots[j]) {
        html += '<div class=\"city-reel-item ' + classes[j] + '\">&nbsp;</div>';
      } else {
        html += '<div class=\"city-reel-item ' + classes[j] + '\">' +
          cityReelEscape(slots[j]) + '</div>';
      }
    }

    cityReelElement.innerHTML = html;
  }

  function displayEventPointForPosition(positionIndex) {
    var idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(Number(positionIndex || 0), route.length - 1));

    // Generated departure/return points can already be on the next trip date.
    // For all visible current-date UI, stay on the most recent real event.
    for (var i = idx; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
      if (route[i] && route[i].is_real_event) {
        return route[i];
      }
    }

    return route[idx] || null;
  }

  function displayDateForPosition(positionIndex) {
    var displayPoint = displayEventPointForPosition(positionIndex);
    return displayPoint ? (displayPoint.date_label || '') : '';
  }

  function updateBrandHud(point, displayDateLabel, calendarPoint) {
    if (!point) return;

    if (brandDateElement) {
      brandDateElement.textContent =
        displayDateLabel || point.date_label || '';
    }

    if (brandLocationElement) {
      var locationText = '';

      if (point.is_traveling) {
        locationText = point.start_destination || '';
      } else {
        locationText = point.destination || '';
        var countyText = point.county || '';

        if (
          countyText &&
          locationText.toLowerCase().indexOf(countyText.toLowerCase()) === -1
        ) {
          locationText += ', ' + countyText + ' County';
        }
      }

      brandLocationElement.textContent = locationText;
      brandLocationElement.classList.toggle(
        'brand-location-long',
        locationText.length >= 39
      );
    }

    if (brandMilesTravelledElement) {
      // Daily mileage shown here is for the date currently displayed.
      // The odometer remains cumulative.
      var mileagePoint = calendarPoint || point;
      var displayedDailyMiles = mileagePoint
        ? Number(mileagePoint.daily_reported_miles)
        : NaN;

      brandMilesTravelledElement.textContent =
        Number.isFinite(displayedDailyMiles)
          ? Math.round(displayedDailyMiles).toLocaleString('en-US')
          : '—';
    }

    if (brandEventCountElement) {
      brandEventCountElement.textContent =
        Number(point.event_count_so_far || 0).toLocaleString('en-US');
    }

    renderYearCalendar(calendarPoint || point);
  }

  var completedPath = L.polyline([], {
    color: '#24103D',
    weight: 1.25,
    opacity: 0.30,
    lineCap: 'round'
  }).addTo(completedLines);

  var activeLine = L.polyline([], {
    color: '#24103D',
    weight: 3.4,
    opacity: 1,
    lineCap: 'round'
  }).addTo(movingLayer);

  var movingMarker = L.circleMarker(
    [Number(route[0].lat), Number(route[0].lng)],
    {
      radius: 7,
      color: '#ffffff',
      weight: 2,
      fillColor: '#4E2D7E',
      fillOpacity: 1
    }
  ).addTo(movingLayer);

  // Widen the existing Leaflet SVG renderer after county and route layers exist.
  // This prevents the mobile 100px pane shift from exposing an undrawn strip.
  function widenVectorRenderer() {
    var renderer = null;

    map.eachLayer(function(layer) {
      if (
        !renderer &&
        layer &&
        layer._renderer &&
        layer._renderer._bounds
      ) {
        renderer = layer._renderer;
      }
    });

    if (!renderer) return false;

    renderer.options.padding = 0.5;

    if (typeof renderer._update === 'function') {
      renderer._update();
    }

    map.eachLayer(function(layer) {
      if (
        layer &&
        layer._renderer === renderer &&
        typeof layer._reset === 'function'
      ) {
        layer._reset();
      }
    });

    return true;
  }

  widenVectorRenderer();

  var minnesotaBounds = L.latLngBounds(
    [43.49, -97.24],
    [49.38, -89.49]
  );

  // Mobile and desktop use different camera strategies.
  // Desktop keeps the established whole-state composition.
  // MOBILE PROOF TEST: verify execution, sizing, camera coordinates, and Canvas placement.
  function applyMinnesotaCamera() {
    if (isMobileLayout) {
      map.invalidateSize({ animate: false, pan: false });
      var mapSize = map.getSize();

      var sideMargin = 10;
      var targetTop = 87;
      var targetBottom = 570;
      var targetHeight = targetBottom - targetTop;
      var maxWidth = mapSize.x - sideMargin * 2;

      var nw0 = map.project([
        minnesotaBounds.getNorth(),
        minnesotaBounds.getWest()
      ], 0);
      var se0 = map.project([
        minnesotaBounds.getSouth(),
        minnesotaBounds.getEast()
      ], 0);
      var baseW = Math.abs(se0.x - nw0.x);
      var baseH = Math.abs(se0.y - nw0.y);

      // Fit by whichever dimension is tighter so the whole state remains visible.
      var desiredZoom = Math.log(
        Math.min(targetHeight / baseH, maxWidth / baseW)
      ) / Math.log(2);

      var zoomSnap = Number(map.options.zoomSnap || 0);
      if (zoomSnap > 0) {
        // Round down so zoom snapping can never make the state overflow.
        desiredZoom = Math.floor(desiredZoom / zoomSnap) * zoomSnap;
      }
      desiredZoom = Math.max(
        map.getMinZoom(),
        Math.min(map.getMaxZoom(), desiredZoom)
      );

      var pNW = map.project([
        minnesotaBounds.getNorth(),
        minnesotaBounds.getWest()
      ], desiredZoom);
      var pSE = map.project([
        minnesotaBounds.getSouth(),
        minnesotaBounds.getEast()
      ], desiredZoom);

      // Keep Minnesota's western edge at a fixed small margin.
      // The camera owns all mobile map positioning; CSS does not shift panes.
      var targetLeft = sideMargin - 10;
      var targetCenterY = (targetTop + targetBottom) / 2;

      var centerProjected = L.point(
        pNW.x + mapSize.x / 2 - targetLeft,
        (pNW.y + pSE.y) / 2 + mapSize.y / 2 - targetCenterY
      );

      map.setView(
        map.unproject(centerProjected, desiredZoom),
        desiredZoom,
        { animate: false, reset: true }
      );
      return;
    }

    var minnesotaTarget = {
      left: 15,
      top: 137,
      right: 405,
      bottom: 597
    };
    var targetWidth = minnesotaTarget.right - minnesotaTarget.left;
    var targetHeight = minnesotaTarget.bottom - minnesotaTarget.top;

    map.fitBounds(minnesotaBounds, { animate: false, padding: [8, 8] });
    var nw = map.latLngToContainerPoint([
      minnesotaBounds.getNorth(), minnesotaBounds.getWest()
    ]);
    var se = map.latLngToContainerPoint([
      minnesotaBounds.getSouth(), minnesotaBounds.getEast()
    ]);
    var currentWidth = Math.abs(se.x - nw.x);
    var currentHeight = Math.abs(se.y - nw.y);
    var widthRatio = targetWidth / currentWidth;
    var heightRatio = targetHeight / currentHeight;
    var scaleRatio = Math.min(widthRatio, heightRatio);
    var zoomDelta = Math.log(scaleRatio) / Math.log(2);
    map.setZoom(map.getZoom() + zoomDelta, { animate: false });
    nw = map.latLngToContainerPoint([
      minnesotaBounds.getNorth(), minnesotaBounds.getWest()
    ]);
    se = map.latLngToContainerPoint([
      minnesotaBounds.getSouth(), minnesotaBounds.getEast()
    ]);
    var stateCenterX = (nw.x + se.x) / 2;
    var stateCenterY = (nw.y + se.y) / 2;
    var targetCenterX = (minnesotaTarget.left + minnesotaTarget.right) / 2;
    var targetCenterY = (minnesotaTarget.top + minnesotaTarget.bottom) / 2;
    map.panBy(
      [stateCenterX - targetCenterX, stateCenterY - targetCenterY],
      { animate: false }
    );
  }

  // One mobile camera pass. Vector layers created above use SVG on mobile,
  // so no Canvas padding/redraw workaround is needed.
  if (isMobileLayout) {
    window.requestAnimationFrame(function() {
      applyMinnesotaCamera();
    });
  } else {
    applyMinnesotaCamera();
  }

  // Recompute SVG bounds after camera/layout changes and whenever the map resizes.
  window.requestAnimationFrame(function() {
    widenVectorRenderer();
  });

  map.on('resize', function() {
    window.requestAnimationFrame(function() {
      widenVectorRenderer();
    });
  });

  var dayStartIndices = [];
  var dayDates = [];

  route.forEach(function(point, index) {
    if (index === 0 || point.event_date !== route[index - 1].event_date) {
      dayStartIndices.push(index);
      dayDates.push(point.event_date);
    }
  });

  var control = L.control({
    position: 'topright'
  });

      '<div class=\"mileage-counter\">' +

    L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);

  };

  control.addTo(map);

  var previousDayButton = document.getElementById(

  var timelineSlider = document.getElementById(

  var timelineCurrentElement = document.getElementById(

  var statusElement = document.getElementById(

  var mileageValueElement = document.getElementById(

  var brandLocationElement = document.getElementById(

  );

  var brandEventCountElement = document.getElementById(

  );
  var cityReelElement = document.getElementById(
    'city-reel-' + el.id
  );

  );

  var earthTotalMilesElement = document.getElementById(
```
