  );
  var earthTotalTurnsElement = document.getElementById(
    'earth-total-turns'
  );
  var earthCompleteLapsElement = document.getElementById(
    'earth-complete-laps'
  );
  var earthCurrentLapMilesElement = document.getElementById(
    'earth-current-lap-miles'
  );
  var earthProgressFillElement = document.getElementById(
    'earth-progress-fill'
  );
  var earthLapLabelElement = document.getElementById(
    'earth-lap-label'
  );
  var earthProgressPercentElement = document.getElementById(
    'earth-progress-percent'
  );
  var earthCurrentDateElement = document.getElementById(
    'earth-current-date'
  );
  var earthCompletedRingElement = document.getElementById(
    'equator-completed-ring'
  );
  var earthProgressRingElement = document.getElementById(
    'equator-progress-ring'
  );
  var earthProgressMarkerElement = document.getElementById(
    'equator-progress-marker'
  );

  var equatorCircumferenceMiles = Math.max(
    1,
    Number(data.equatorCircumferenceMiles) || 24901
  );

  function clamp(value, minimum, maximum) {
    return Math.min(maximum, Math.max(minimum, value));
  }

  function hasNumericValue(value) {
    return (
      value !== null &&
      value !== undefined &&
      value !== '' &&
      Number.isFinite(Number(value))
    );
  }

  function formatMileage(value) {
    var numericValue = hasNumericValue(value)
      ? Number(value)
      : 0;

    return Math.round(numericValue).toLocaleString('en-US');
  }

  var earthRotatingSurfaceElement = document.getElementById(
    'earth-rotating-surface'
  );
  var earthDriverGroupElement = document.getElementById(
    'earth-driver-group'
  );
  var earthDriverGapCutoutElement = document.getElementById(
    'earth-driver-gap-cutout'
  );
  var earthLapTrailElements = [
    document.getElementById('earth-lap-trail-0'),
    document.getElementById('earth-lap-trail-1'),
    document.getElementById('earth-lap-trail-2'),
    document.getElementById('earth-lap-trail-3')
  ].filter(Boolean);

  var earthDriveMilesElement = document.getElementById(
    'earth-drive-miles'
  );
  var earthTurnValueElement = earthDriveMilesElement;

  /* ================= FINAL SHARED 3D GLOBE ENGINE =================
     One coordinate system for land, trail and Erik:
       world lon/lat -> unit sphere -> camera rotation -> orthographic -> screen

     The camera is lap-aware. Erik reaches the right limb at every lap seam,
     holds there briefly while the new trail builds, then the camera catches
     up and brings him inward. The active trail is stored world-coordinate
     history and is clipped exactly at the sphere horizon.
  */

  var EARTH_GLOBE = {
    centerX: 280,
    centerY: 160,
    radius: 128,

    // Start the around-the-world comparison near Minnesota rather than Greenwich.
    startLongitude: -95,

    leadEdge: 76,
    leadNear: 14,
    leadFar: 50,
    leadStartFirstLap: 26,

    edgeHoldEnd: 0.055,
    catchUpEnd: 0.18,
    swingEnd: 0.70,
    swingCycles: 1.0,

    trailGapMiles: 900,
    trailGapMaxMiles: 3600,
    trailGapPixels: 20,

    // Final screen-space safety gap around Erik. The marker halo reaches
    // about 21 px from center; 29 px leaves ~8 px of visible breathing room.
    // This mask is applied after projection, so it also protects completed laps
    // that happen to pass behind Erik on screen.
    driverTrailExclusionPixels: 29,

    samplesPerLap: 720
  };

  function eRad(d) {
    return d * Math.PI / 180;
  }

  function eEase(t) {
    t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
    return 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(Math.PI * t);
  }

  function eUnit(w) {
    var lon = eRad(w.longitude);
    var lat = eRad(w.latitude);
    var c = Math.cos(lat);
    return {
      x: c * Math.sin(lon),
      y: Math.sin(lat),
      z: c * Math.cos(lon)
    };
  }

  function eRotate(u, camLon) {
    var a = eRad(-camLon);
    var ca = Math.cos(a);
    var sa = Math.sin(a);
    return {
      x: u.x * ca + u.z * sa,
      y: u.y,
      z: -u.x * sa + u.z * ca
    };
  }

  function eProject(r) {
    return {
      x: EARTH_GLOBE.centerX + EARTH_GLOBE.radius * r.x,
      y: EARTH_GLOBE.centerY - EARTH_GLOBE.radius * r.y,
      depth: r.z,
      visible: r.z >= 0
    };
  }

  function eTransform(w, camLon) {
    return eProject(eRotate(eUnit(w), camLon));
  }

  function eHorizon(a, b) {
    var den = a.z - b.z;
    var t = Math.abs(den) < 1e-9 ? 0.5 : a.z / den;
    t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
    var p = {
      x: a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t,
      y: a.y + (b.y - a.y) * t,
      z: 0
    };
    var m = Math.sqrt(p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y) || 1;
    p.x /= m;
    p.y /= m;
    return p;
  }

  function eLapLatitude(lapIndex, p) {
    p = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p));
    var a = 2 * Math.PI * p;

    // Stay visually close to the equator. Later laps get only a tiny
    // temporary offset so separate trips can still be distinguished.
    var base = 2.25 * Math.sin(a);
    var offsets = [0, -5, 5, -7];
    var off = offsets[Math.min(lapIndex, offsets.length - 1)];

    return base + off * Math.sin(Math.PI * p);
  }

  function eWorldPoint(lapIndex, p) {
    p = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p));
    return {
      longitude: EARTH_GLOBE.startLongitude + 360 * (lapIndex + p),
      latitude: eLapLatitude(lapIndex, p)
    };
  }

  function eLeadAngle(totalTurns) {
    var G = EARTH_GLOBE;
    var lap = Math.floor(totalTurns);
    var p = totalTurns - lap;
    var startLead = (lap === 0) ? G.leadStartFirstLap : G.leadEdge;

    if (p < G.edgeHoldEnd) return startLead;

    if (p < G.catchUpEnd) {
      var t = (p - G.edgeHoldEnd) / (G.catchUpEnd - G.edgeHoldEnd);
      return startLead + (G.leadNear - startLead) * eEase(t);
    }

    if (p < G.swingEnd) {
      var s = (p - G.catchUpEnd) / (G.swingEnd - G.catchUpEnd);

      // One complete, smooth drift cycle: near -> far -> near.
      // It starts and ends with zero slope, so there is no camera-rate jump.
      return G.leadNear + (G.leadFar - G.leadNear) *
        0.5 * (1 - Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * G.swingCycles * s));
    }

    var u = (p - G.swingEnd) / (1 - G.swingEnd);

    // The middle drift ends back at leadNear, so the run-out begins from
    // exactly the same lead and eases continuously toward the lap seam.
    return G.leadNear + (G.leadEdge - G.leadNear) * eEase(u);
  }

  function eCameraLongitude(totalTurns) {
    return EARTH_GLOBE.startLongitude +
      360 * totalTurns -
      eLeadAngle(totalTurns);
  }

  var eTrailHistory = [];

  function eBuildHistories() {
    if (eTrailHistory.length) return;
    for (var k = 0; k < earthLapTrailElements.length; k += 1) {
      var h = [];
      for (var i = 0; i <= EARTH_GLOBE.samplesPerLap; i += 1) {
        var worldPoint = eWorldPoint(k, i / EARTH_GLOBE.samplesPerLap);
        h.push({
          world: worldPoint,
          unit: eUnit(worldPoint)
        });
      }
      eTrailHistory.push(h);
    }
  }

  var eLandPolys = null;
  var eLandPath = document.getElementById('earth-projected-land');

  function eBuildLand() {
    if (eLandPolys) return;
    eLandPolys = [];
    (data.worldShapes || []).forEach(function(shape) {
      var lat = shape.lat || [];
      var lng = shape.lng || [];
      var n = Math.min(lat.length, lng.length);
      if (n < 3) return;
      var step = n > 400 ? Math.ceil(n / 400) : 1;
      var poly = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < n; i += step) {
        var la = Number(lat[i]);
        var lo = Number(lng[i]);
        if (Number.isFinite(la) && Number.isFinite(lo)) {
          poly.push(eUnit({ longitude: lo, latitude: la }));
        }
      }
      if (poly.length >= 3) eLandPolys.push(poly);
    });
  }

  function eLandPathData(camLon) {
    eBuildLand();
    var parts = [];

    eLandPolys.forEach(function(poly) {
      var rot = poly.map(function(unitPoint) {
        return eRotate(unitPoint, camLon);
      });
      var runs = [];
      var run = [];

      for (var i = 0; i < rot.length; i += 1) {
        var a = rot[i];
        var b = rot[(i + 1) % rot.length];

        if (a.z >= 0 && run.length === 0) run.push(a);

        if (a.z >= 0 && b.z >= 0) {
          run.push(b);
        } else if (a.z >= 0 && b.z < 0) {
          run.push(eHorizon(a, b));
          if (run.length >= 3) runs.push(run);
          run = [];
        } else if (a.z < 0 && b.z >= 0) {
          run = [eHorizon(a, b), b];
        }
      }

      if (run.length >= 3) runs.push(run);
      if (rot.every(function(p) { return p.z >= 0; })) runs = [rot];

      runs.forEach(function(pts) {
        if (pts.length < 3) return;
        var f = eProject(pts[0]);
        var d = 'M' + f.x.toFixed(2) + ' ' + f.y.toFixed(2);
        for (var j = 1; j < pts.length; j += 1) {
          var q = eProject(pts[j]);
          d += ' L' + q.x.toFixed(2) + ' ' + q.y.toFixed(2);
        }
        parts.push(d + ' Z');
      });
    });

    return parts.join(' ');
  }

  function eTrailPathData(lapIndex, endIndex, camLon) {
    eBuildHistories();
    var hist = eTrailHistory[lapIndex] || [];
    if (!hist.length || endIndex < 1) return '';
    if (endIndex > hist.length - 1) endIndex = hist.length - 1;

    var d = '';
    var open = false;
    var prev = null;

    for (var i = 0; i <= endIndex; i += 1) {
      var r = eRotate(hist[i].unit, camLon);
      if (r.z >= 0) {
        var p = eProject(r);
        if (!open) {
          if (prev) {
            var hIn = eProject(eHorizon(prev, r));
            d += ' M' + hIn.x.toFixed(2) + ' ' + hIn.y.toFixed(2) +
                 ' L' + p.x.toFixed(2) + ' ' + p.y.toFixed(2);
          } else {
            d += ' M' + p.x.toFixed(2) + ' ' + p.y.toFixed(2);
          }
          open = true;
        } else {
          d += ' L' + p.x.toFixed(2) + ' ' + p.y.toFixed(2);
        }
      } else {
        if (open && prev) {
          var hOut = eProject(eHorizon(prev, r));
          d += ' L' + hOut.x.toFixed(2) + ' ' + hOut.y.toFixed(2);
        }
        open = false;
      }
      prev = r;
    }

    return d.trim();
  }

  function eRevealIndex(lapIndex, milesIntoLap, camLon, erikPt) {
    eBuildHistories();
    var hist = eTrailHistory[lapIndex] || [];
    if (!hist.length) return 0;

    var last = hist.length - 1;
    var milesPerSample = equatorCircumferenceMiles / last;
    var erikIdx = Math.min(last, Math.floor(milesIntoLap / milesPerSample));

    var idx = erikIdx - Math.ceil(EARTH_GLOBE.trailGapMiles / milesPerSample);
    if (idx <= 0) return 0;

    var floorIdx = Math.max(
      0,
      erikIdx - Math.ceil(EARTH_GLOBE.trailGapMaxMiles / milesPerSample)
    );

    while (idx > floorIdx) {
      var r = eRotate(hist[idx].unit, camLon);
      if (r.z < 0) break;
      var q = eProject(r);
      var dx = q.x - erikPt.x;
      var dy = q.y - erikPt.y;
      if (Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) >= EARTH_GLOBE.trailGapPixels) break;
      idx -= 1;
    }
    return idx;
  }

  function updateEarthProgress(value, point) {
    var miles = hasNumericValue(value) ? Math.max(0, Number(value)) : 0;

    var totalTurns = miles / equatorCircumferenceMiles;
    var completedLaps = Math.floor(totalTurns);
    var lapMiles = miles % equatorCircumferenceMiles;
    var lapFraction = lapMiles / equatorCircumferenceMiles;

    if (earthTotalMilesElement) earthTotalMilesElement.textContent = formatMileage(miles);
    if (earthTotalTurnsElement) earthTotalTurnsElement.textContent = totalTurns.toFixed(2) + '×';
    if (earthCompleteLapsElement) earthCompleteLapsElement.textContent = completedLaps.toLocaleString('en-US');
    if (earthCurrentLapMilesElement) earthCurrentLapMilesElement.textContent = formatMileage(lapMiles);
    if (earthProgressFillElement) earthProgressFillElement.style.width = (lapFraction * 100) + '%';
    if (earthLapLabelElement) earthLapLabelElement.textContent = 'Trip ' + (completedLaps + 1) + ' around Earth';
    if (earthProgressPercentElement) earthProgressPercentElement.textContent = Math.round(lapFraction * 100) + '%';

    var maxLap = earthLapTrailElements.length - 1;
    var cappedTurns = Math.min(totalTurns, maxLap + 1);
    var activeLap = Math.min(completedLaps, maxLap);
    var activeProgress = (completedLaps > maxLap) ? 1 : lapFraction;

    var erik = eWorldPoint(activeLap, activeProgress);
    var camLon = eCameraLongitude(cappedTurns);
    var erikPt = eTransform(erik, camLon);

    // Final visual safety check: punch a small screen-space hole in every
    // mileage trail around Erik. This does not alter the 3D route, camera,
    // horizon clipping, lap histories, or existing mileage-based reveal gap.
    if (earthDriverGapCutoutElement) {
      earthDriverGapCutoutElement.setAttribute('cx', erikPt.x.toFixed(2));
      earthDriverGapCutoutElement.setAttribute('cy', erikPt.y.toFixed(2));
      earthDriverGapCutoutElement.setAttribute(
        'r',
        erikPt.visible ? EARTH_GLOBE.driverTrailExclusionPixels : 0
      );
    }

    if (eLandPath) eLandPath.setAttribute('d', eLandPathData(camLon));

    eBuildHistories();
    var lastSample = EARTH_GLOBE.samplesPerLap;

    earthLapTrailElements.forEach(function(path, lapIndex) {
      path.classList.remove('completed-lap', 'current-lap');

      if (totalTurns <= lapIndex) {
        path.setAttribute('d', '');
        path.style.opacity = '0';
        return;
      }

      if (totalTurns >= lapIndex + 1) {
        path.setAttribute('d', eTrailPathData(lapIndex, lastSample, camLon));
        path.classList.add('completed-lap');
        path.style.opacity = '0.40';
        return;
      }

      var milesIntoLap = (totalTurns - lapIndex) * equatorCircumferenceMiles;
      var endIdx = eRevealIndex(lapIndex, milesIntoLap, camLon, erikPt);

      if (endIdx < 1) {
        path.setAttribute('d', '');
        path.style.opacity = '0';
        return;
      }

      path.setAttribute('d', eTrailPathData(lapIndex, endIdx, camLon));
      path.classList.add('current-lap');
      path.style.opacity = '0.98';
    });

    if (earthDriverGroupElement) {
      earthDriverGroupElement.setAttribute(
        'transform',
        'translate(' + erikPt.x.toFixed(2) + ' ' + erikPt.y.toFixed(2) + ')'
      );
      earthDriverGroupElement.style.opacity = erikPt.visible ? '1' : '0';
    }

    if (earthTurnValueElement) {
      earthTurnValueElement.textContent = totalTurns.toFixed(2) + '×';
    }

    if (earthCurrentDateElement) {
      earthCurrentDateElement.textContent = (point && point.date_label)
        ? point.date_label + ': ' + formatMileage(miles) +
          ' cumulative miles, equivalent to ' + totalTurns.toFixed(2) +
          ' trips around Earth.'
        : 'Waiting for the route animation to begin.';
    }
  }

  function renderOdometerMileage(value) {
    if (!mileageValueElement) return;

    var roundedValue = hasNumericValue(value)
      ? Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(value)))
      : 0;

    // Six fixed mechanical windows gives the counter a true odometer feel.
    // Example: 925 -> 000925, 33,873 -> 033873.
    var digits = String(roundedValue).padStart(5, '0');

    if (digits.length > 5) {
      digits = digits.slice(-5);
    }

    var firstSignificantIndex = digits.search(/[1-9]/);

    if (firstSignificantIndex === -1) {
      firstSignificantIndex = digits.length - 1;
    }

    mileageValueElement.innerHTML = digits
      .split('')
      .map(function(digit, index) {
        var leadingClass =
          index < firstSignificantIndex && digit === '0'
            ? ' leading-zero'
            : '';

        return (index === 2
          ? '<span class=\"odometer-comma\">,</span>'
          : '') +
          '<span class=\"odometer-digit' +
          leadingClass +
          '\">' + digit + '</span>';
      })
      .join('');
  }

  function updateMileage(value, point) {
    currentDisplayedMileage = hasNumericValue(value)
      ? Number(value)
      : 0;
    currentMileagePoint = point || currentMileagePoint;

    renderOdometerMileage(currentDisplayedMileage);

    if (!point) {
      mileageDayElement.textContent = '';
      return;
    }

    var dailyMileage = Number(point.daily_reported_miles);

    if (point.is_future_event) {
      mileageDayElement.textContent =
        point.date_label + ': planned trip — future mileage not counted';
    } else if (hasNumericValue(point.daily_reported_miles)) {
      mileageDayElement.textContent =
        point.date_label + ': ' +
        formatMileage(dailyMileage) +
        ' reported mi';
    } else {
      mileageDayElement.textContent =
        point.date_label +
        ': mileage unavailable';
    }
  }

  function pointLabel(point) {
    var eventCount = Number(point.event_count_so_far || 0);
    var coveredText =
      'Events covered: ' + eventCount.toLocaleString('en-US');

    if (point.is_future_event) {
      if (point.route_type === 'home_departure') {
        return (
          'Planned departure from Wadena — ' +
          point.date_label +
          ' — ' +
          coveredText
        );
      }

      if (point.route_type === 'home_return') {
        return (
          'Planned return to Wadena — ' +
          point.date_label +
          ' — ' +
          coveredText
        );
      }

      return (
        'Planned event: ' +
        point.destination +
        ' — ' +
        point.date_label +
        ' — ' +
        coveredText
      );
    }

    if (point.route_type === 'home_departure') {
      return (
        'Starting from Wadena — ' +
        point.date_label +
        ' — ' +
        coveredText
      );
    }

    if (point.route_type === 'home_return') {
      return (
        'Returning to Wadena — ' +
        point.date_label +
        ' — ' +
        coveredText
      );
    }

    return (
      point.destination +
      ' — ' +
      point.date_label +
      ' — ' +
      coveredText
    );
  }

  function updateStatus(text) {
    statusElement.textContent = text;
  }

  function createVisitedMarker(index, pointType, currentIndex) {
    var point = route[index];
    var radius = 3;
    var fillColor = '#3F3F46';

    // Recent cities stay deep gray and full-size.
    // Older cities gradually fade AND get smaller as they recede in the journey.
    var age = Math.max(0, Number(currentIndex || 0) - index);
    var recentWindow = 8;

    var fillOpacity = 1;
    if (age > recentWindow) {
      fillOpacity = Math.max(
        0.30,
        1 - ((age - recentWindow) * 0.018)
      );

      radius = Math.max(
        1.7,
        3 - ((age - recentWindow) * 0.025)
      );
    }

    var isHomePoint =
      point.route_type === 'home_departure' ||
      point.route_type === 'home_return';

    if (isHomePoint) {
      radius = 4.5;
      fillColor = '#4E2D7E';
      fillOpacity = 1;
    }

    if (pointType === 'start') {
      radius = 5.5;
      fillColor = '#16a34a';
    } else if (pointType === 'finish') {
      radius = 5.5;
      fillColor = '#dc2626';
      fillOpacity = 1;
    }

    var marker = L.circleMarker(
      [Number(point.lat), Number(point.lng)],
      {
        radius: radius,
        color: isHomePoint ? '#ffffff' : fillColor,
        weight: isHomePoint ? 2 : 0,
        fillColor: fillColor,
        fillOpacity: fillOpacity
      }
    );

    marker.bindTooltip(
      point.popup_html,
      {
        sticky: true
      }
    );

    return marker;
  }

  function rebuildVisitedPoints(wholeIndex) {
    if (wholeIndex === lastVisitedIndex) {
      return;
    }

    visitedPoints.clearLayers();

    for (var index = 0; index <= wholeIndex; index += 1) {
      var pointType = 'normal';

      if (index === 0) {
        pointType = 'start';
      } else if (index === maxPosition && wholeIndex === maxPosition) {
        pointType = 'finish';
      }

      visitedPoints.addLayer(
        createVisitedMarker(index, pointType, wholeIndex)
      );
    }

    lastVisitedIndex = wholeIndex;
  }

  function mileageAtPosition(baseIndex, fraction) {
    if (baseIndex >= maxPosition) {
      return hasNumericValue(route[maxPosition].cumulative_miles)
        ? Number(route[maxPosition].cumulative_miles)
        : 0;
    }

    var startingMileage = hasNumericValue(route[baseIndex].cumulative_miles)
      ? Number(route[baseIndex].cumulative_miles)
      : 0;

    var segmentMiles = hasNumericValue(route[baseIndex + 1].segment_miles)
      ? Number(route[baseIndex + 1].segment_miles)
      : 0;

    return startingMileage + segmentMiles * fraction;
  }

  function earthMileageAtPosition(baseIndex, fraction) {
    if (baseIndex >= maxPosition) {
      return hasNumericValue(route[maxPosition].earth_cumulative_miles)
        ? Number(route[maxPosition].earth_cumulative_miles)
        : 0;
    }

    var startingEarthMileage =
      hasNumericValue(route[baseIndex].earth_cumulative_miles)
        ? Number(route[baseIndex].earth_cumulative_miles)
        : 0;

    var earthSegmentMiles =
      hasNumericValue(route[baseIndex + 1].earth_segment_miles)
        ? Number(route[baseIndex + 1].earth_segment_miles)
        : 0;

    return startingEarthMileage + earthSegmentMiles * fraction;
  }


  var journeyCaptionState = {
    key: null,
    hideTimer: null,
    swapTimer: null
  };

  function hideJourneyCaption() {
    if (!storyJourneyCaptionElement) {
      return;
    }
    storyJourneyCaptionElement.classList.remove('is-visible');
  }

  function showJourneyCaption(key, headline, subline, durationMs) {
    if (!storyJourneyCaptionElement) {
      return;
    }

    if (journeyCaptionState.key === key) {
      return;
    }

    journeyCaptionState.key = key;

    if (journeyCaptionState.hideTimer !== null) {
      window.clearTimeout(journeyCaptionState.hideTimer);
      journeyCaptionState.hideTimer = null;
    }

    if (journeyCaptionState.swapTimer !== null) {
      window.clearTimeout(journeyCaptionState.swapTimer);
      journeyCaptionState.swapTimer = null;
    }

    // Smooth handoff:
    // old text gently drops/fades out -> brief breathing gap ->
    // new text rises/fades in.
    storyJourneyCaptionElement.classList.remove('is-visible');
    storyJourneyCaptionElement.classList.add('is-exiting');

    var exitDuration = scaledDelay(520);
    var breathingGap = scaledDelay(130);

    journeyCaptionState.swapTimer = window.setTimeout(function() {
      if (!storyJourneyCaptionElement) {
        return;
      }

      storyJourneyCaptionElement.innerHTML =
        headline +
        (subline
          ? '<span class=\"story-journey-small\">' +
            subline +
            '</span>'
          : '');

      storyJourneyCaptionElement.classList.remove('is-exiting');
      storyJourneyCaptionElement.style.transition = 'none';
      storyJourneyCaptionElement.style.opacity = '0';
      storyJourneyCaptionElement.style.transform = 'translateY(-3px)';

      // Force the browser to commit the starting state before animating in.
      void storyJourneyCaptionElement.offsetWidth;

      window.setTimeout(function() {
        storyJourneyCaptionElement.style.transition = '';
        storyJourneyCaptionElement.style.opacity = '';
        storyJourneyCaptionElement.style.transform = '';
        storyJourneyCaptionElement.classList.add('is-visible');
      }, breathingGap);

      journeyCaptionState.hideTimer = null;
      journeyCaptionState.swapTimer = null;
    }, exitDuration);
  }

  function updateJourneyCaption(position) {
    var storyWholeIndex = Math.floor(position);
    var storyFraction = position - storyWholeIndex;
    var storyEarthMiles =
      earthMileageAtPosition(storyWholeIndex, storyFraction);

    // Find where the longer distance-reveal chapter begins.
    // The first four chapters divide all animation time before this point
    // into four equal sections.
    if (distanceSetupRoutePosition === null) {
      distanceSetupRoutePosition = maxPosition;

      for (var setupIndex = 0; setupIndex <= maxPosition; setupIndex += 1) {
        if (earthMileageAtPosition(setupIndex, 0) >= distanceSetupMiles) {
          distanceSetupRoutePosition = setupIndex;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    // Treat the 24,901-mile moment like every other story chapter.
    // It appears when the route reaches one Earth circumference and then
    // stays on screen for a meaningful portion of the remaining journey.
    if (storyEarthMiles >= milestoneMiles) {
      var milestonePosition = maxPosition;
      for (var milestoneIndex = 0; milestoneIndex <= maxPosition; milestoneIndex += 1) {
        if (earthMileageAtPosition(milestoneIndex, 0) >= milestoneMiles) {
          milestonePosition = milestoneIndex;
          break;
        }
      }

      var postMilestoneProgress =
        maxPosition > milestonePosition
          ? (position - milestonePosition) / (maxPosition - milestonePosition)
          : 0;

      if (postMilestoneProgress < 0.30) {
        if (storyJourneyCaptionElement) {
          storyJourneyCaptionElement.classList.remove('is-earth-milestone');
        }

        showJourneyCaption(
          'earth-milestone',
          '24,901 MILES',
          'Enough to circle the Earth',
          12000
        );
        return;
      }

      if (postMilestoneProgress < 0.65) {
        showJourneyCaption(
          'earth-after',
          'And he wasn&#39;t done',
          'Because building relationships takes more than one visit',
          12000
        );
      } else {
        showJourneyCaption(
          'kept-coming-back',
          'He kept coming back',
          'Deepening connections · Building trust · Staying engaged',
          12000
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    // Keep this setup on screen longer immediately before the Earth reveal.
    if (storyEarthMiles >= distanceSetupMiles) {
      showJourneyCaption(
        'distance-story',
        'The distance became hard to imagine',
        'Until you compare it to something bigger',
        16000
      );
      return;
    }

    var preRevealProgress =
      distanceSetupRoutePosition > 0
        ? position / distanceSetupRoutePosition
        : 0;

    if (preRevealProgress < 0.20) {
      showJourneyCaption(
        'journey-begins',
        'It starts by showing up',
        'From Wadena, the road leads to the people',
        12000
      );
      return;
    }

    if (preRevealProgress < 0.40) {
      showJourneyCaption(
        'conversation',
        'One conversation became another',
        'Listening to what&#39;s on people&#39;s hearts and minds',
        12000
      );
      return;
    }

    if (preRevealProgress < 0.60) {
      showJourneyCaption(
        'community',
        'Connections became community',
        'Town by town · County by county · Face to face',
        12000
      );
      return;
    }

    if (preRevealProgress < 0.80) {
      showJourneyCaption(
        'showing-up',
        'The miles weren&#39;t the point',
        'Every mile meant another person, another conversation',
        12000
      );
      return;
    }

    showJourneyCaption(
      'keep-showing-up',
      'He kept showing up',
      'Listening first · Building trust · Making connections',
      12000
    );
  }

  function renderAtPosition(position) {
    currentPosition = clamp(Number(position) || 0, 0, maxPosition);

    var wholeIndex = Math.floor(currentPosition);
    var fraction = currentPosition - wholeIndex;

    if (currentPosition >= maxPosition) {
      wholeIndex = maxPosition;
      fraction = 0;
    }

    var completedCoordinates = [];

    for (var index = 0; index <= wholeIndex; index += 1) {
      completedCoordinates.push([
        Number(route[index].lat),
        Number(route[index].lng)
      ]);
    }

    completedPath.setLatLngs(completedCoordinates);
    rebuildVisitedPoints(wholeIndex);
    updateCountyHighlights(wholeIndex);
    updateBrandHud(
      route[wholeIndex],
      displayDateForPosition(wholeIndex),
      displayEventPointForPosition(wholeIndex)
    );
    updateCityReel(wholeIndex);

    var markerLat = Number(route[wholeIndex].lat);
    var markerLng = Number(route[wholeIndex].lng);
    var displayPoint = route[wholeIndex];

    if (fraction > 0 && wholeIndex < maxPosition) {
      var start = route[wholeIndex];
      var end = route[wholeIndex + 1];

      markerLat =
        Number(start.lat) +
        (Number(end.lat) - Number(start.lat)) * fraction;

      markerLng =
        Number(start.lng) +
        (Number(end.lng) - Number(start.lng)) * fraction;

      activeLine.setLatLngs([
        [Number(start.lat), Number(start.lng)],
        [markerLat, markerLng]
      ]);

      displayPoint = start;

      updateBrandHud({
        date_label: start.date_label || '',
        is_traveling: true,
        start_destination: start.destination || '',
        end_destination: end.destination || '',
        start_county: start.county || '',
        end_county: end.county || '',
        event_count_so_far: Number(start.event_count_so_far || 0)
      },
      displayDateForPosition(wholeIndex),
      displayEventPointForPosition(wholeIndex)
      );

      var eventsCoveredInTransit = Number(
        route[wholeIndex].event_count_so_far || 0
      );
      var coveredText =
        'Events covered: ' +
        eventsCoveredInTransit.toLocaleString('en-US');

      if (end.is_future_event) {
        if (end.route_type === 'home_departure') {
          updateStatus(
            'Planned departure from Wadena — ' +
            end.date_label +
            ' — ' +
            coveredText
          );
        } else if (end.route_type === 'home_return') {
          updateStatus(
            'Planned return to Wadena — ' +
            end.date_label +
            ' — ' +
            coveredText
          );
        } else {
          updateStatus(
            'Planned trip to ' +
            end.destination +
            ' — ' +
            end.date_label +
            ' — ' +
            coveredText
          );
        }
      } else if (end.route_type === 'home_departure') {
        updateStatus(
          'Starting from Wadena — ' +
          end.date_label +
          ' — ' +
          coveredText
        );
      } else if (end.route_type === 'home_return') {
        updateStatus(
          'Returning to Wadena — ' +
          end.date_label +
          ' — ' +
          coveredText
        );
      } else {
        updateStatus(
          'Traveling to ' +
          end.destination +
          ' — ' +
          end.date_label +
          ' — ' +
          coveredText
        );
      }
    } else {
      activeLine.setLatLngs([]);

      if (wholeIndex >= maxPosition) {
        updateStatus(
          'Timeline complete — Events covered: ' +
          Number(data.realEventCount || 0).toLocaleString('en-US') +
          ' — Planned future events: ' +
          Number(data.plannedEventCount || 0).toLocaleString('en-US') +
          ' — ' +
          formatMileage(data.totalAnimatedMileage) +
          ' reported miles completed.'
        );
      } else {
        updateStatus(pointLabel(route[wholeIndex]));
      }
    }

    movingMarker.setLatLng([markerLat, markerLng]);

    var mileage = mileageAtPosition(wholeIndex, fraction);
    updateMileage(mileage, displayPoint);

    // First-lap milestone follows the reported mileage shown in Miles Driven.
    updateEarthFirstLapMilestone(mileage);

    // Earth keeps moving through the full route even when later source rows
    // do not contain reported miles. This does NOT change Miles Driven.
    var earthMileage = earthMileageAtPosition(wholeIndex, fraction);
    updateEarthProgress(earthMileage, displayPoint);

    timelineSlider.value = String(currentPosition);
    updateJourneyCaption(currentPosition);
    timelineSlider.setAttribute(
      'aria-valuetext',
      displayPoint.date_label + ', ' + displayPoint.destination
    );

    timelineCurrentElement.textContent =
      displayPoint.date_label +
      ' — ' +
      displayPoint.destination +
      (fraction > 0 ? ' (in transit)' : '');
  }

  function stopPlayback() {
    playing = false;
    playPauseButton.textContent = '▶';
    lastFrameTimestamp = null;

    if (animationFrame !== null) {
      window.cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
      animationFrame = null;
    }
  }

  function showStoryMilestone() {
    // The milestone is now handled by updateJourneyCaption just like the
    // other story beats. This flag only prevents repeated threshold triggers.
    milestoneShown = true;
  }

  function hideStoryMilestone() {
    // No special milestone positioning/styling. The 24,901-mile chapter uses
    // the same lower-caption layout and transition behavior as every other beat.
  }

  function showStoryEnding() {
    hideStoryMilestone();
    hideJourneyCaption();
    if (storyEndingElement) {
      storyEndingElement.classList.add('is-visible');
    }
  }

  function hideStoryEnding() {
    if (storyEndingElement) {
      storyEndingElement.classList.remove('is-visible');
    }
  }

  function finishPlayback() {
    stopPlayback();
    renderAtPosition(maxPosition);
    showStoryEnding();
  }

  function drawFrame(timestamp) {
    if (!playing) {
      return;
    }

    // Hold the opening scene on the SAME master playback clock.
    // requestAnimationFrame clock as the route.
    if (introActive && storyIntroElement) {
      if (introLastTimestamp === null) {
        introLastTimestamp = timestamp;
      }

      introElapsed += timestamp - introLastTimestamp;
      introLastTimestamp = timestamp;
      lastFrameTimestamp = null;

      if (introElapsed < introHoldDuration) {
        animationFrame = window.requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
        return;
      }

      introActive = false;
      storyIntroElement.classList.add('is-leaving');
      introLastTimestamp = null;

      // Begin route timing cleanly on the next animation frame.
      animationFrame = window.requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
      return;
    }

    if (lastFrameTimestamp === null) {
      lastFrameTimestamp = timestamp;
    }

    var elapsed = timestamp - lastFrameTimestamp;
    lastFrameTimestamp = timestamp;

    currentPosition += (elapsed * speedMultiplier) / baseDuration;

    if (currentPosition >= maxPosition) {
      finishPlayback();
      return;
    }

    renderAtPosition(currentPosition);

    var milestoneWholeIndex = Math.floor(currentPosition);
    var milestoneFraction = currentPosition - milestoneWholeIndex;
    var milestoneCurrentMiles =
      earthMileageAtPosition(milestoneWholeIndex, milestoneFraction);

    if (
      !distanceSetupShown &&
      milestoneCurrentMiles >= distanceSetupMiles &&
      milestoneCurrentMiles < milestoneMiles
    ) {
      distanceSetupShown = true;
      showJourneyCaption(
        'distance-story',
        'Then the distance became hard to imagine',
        'Until you compare it to something bigger',
        12000
      );
    }

    if (!milestoneShown && milestoneCurrentMiles >= milestoneMiles) {
      showStoryMilestone();
    }

    animationFrame = window.requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
  }

  function play() {
    if (playing) {
      return;
    }

    if (currentPosition >= maxPosition) {
      restart(true);
      return;
    }

    hideStoryEnding();
    hideStoryMilestone();

    playing = true;
    playPauseButton.textContent = 'Ⅱ';
    lastFrameTimestamp = null;
    animationFrame = window.requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
  }

  function pause() {
    stopPlayback();
  }

  function restart(autoPlay) {
    stopPlayback();
    hideStoryEnding();
    hideStoryMilestone();
    distanceSetupShown = false;
    milestoneShown = false;
    lastVisitedIndex = -1;
    renderAtPosition(0);

    introElapsed = 0;
    introLastTimestamp = null;
    introActive = true;

    if (storyIntroElement) {
      storyIntroElement.classList.remove('is-leaving');
    }

    if (journeyCaptionState.hideTimer !== null) {
      window.clearTimeout(journeyCaptionState.hideTimer);
      journeyCaptionState.hideTimer = null;
    }

    if (journeyCaptionState.swapTimer !== null) {
      window.clearTimeout(journeyCaptionState.swapTimer);
      journeyCaptionState.swapTimer = null;
    }

    journeyCaptionState.key = null;
    hideJourneyCaption();

    if (autoPlay) {
      play();
    }
  }

  function currentDayIndex() {
    var pointIndex = Math.min(
      maxPosition,
      Math.ceil(currentPosition)
    );
    var currentDate = route[pointIndex].event_date;
    var index = dayDates.indexOf(currentDate);

    return index >= 0 ? index : 0;
  }

  function jumpDay(direction) {
    pause();
    hideStoryEnding();

    var targetDay = clamp(
      currentDayIndex() + direction,
      0,
      dayStartIndices.length - 1
    );

    lastVisitedIndex = -1;
    var targetPosition = dayStartIndices[targetDay];
    hideStoryMilestone();

    var targetWholeIndex = Math.floor(targetPosition);
    var targetFraction = targetPosition - targetWholeIndex;
    var targetEarthMiles =
      earthMileageAtPosition(targetWholeIndex, targetFraction);

    distanceSetupShown = targetEarthMiles >= distanceSetupMiles;
    milestoneShown = targetEarthMiles >= milestoneMiles;

    renderAtPosition(targetPosition);

    if (targetPosition <= 0.001) {
      introElapsed = 0;
      introLastTimestamp = null;
      introActive = true;

      if (storyIntroElement) {
        storyIntroElement.classList.remove('is-leaving');
      }

      journeyCaptionState.key = null;
      hideJourneyCaption();
    } else {
      introActive = false;

      if (storyIntroElement) {
        storyIntroElement.classList.add('is-leaving');
      }
    }
  }

  playPauseButton.addEventListener(
    'click',
    function() {
      if (playing) {
        pause();
      } else {
        play();
      }
    }
  );

  previousDayButton.addEventListener(
    'click',
    function() {
      jumpDay(-1);
    }
  );

  nextDayButton.addEventListener(
    'click',
    function() {
      jumpDay(1);
    }
  );

  restartButton.addEventListener(
    'click',
    function() {
      restart(true);
    }
  );

  speedSelect.addEventListener(
    'change',
    function() {
      speedMultiplier = Number(this.value) || 1;
      applyPlaybackSpeedToTransitions();
      lastFrameTimestamp = null;
      introLastTimestamp = null;
    }
  );

  applyPlaybackSpeedToTransitions();

  timelineSlider.addEventListener(
    'input',
    function() {
      pause();
      hideStoryEnding();
      lastVisitedIndex = -1;

      var sliderPosition = Number(this.value);
      hideStoryMilestone();

      var sliderWholeIndex = Math.floor(sliderPosition);
      var sliderFraction = sliderPosition - sliderWholeIndex;
      var sliderEarthMiles =
        earthMileageAtPosition(sliderWholeIndex, sliderFraction);

      distanceSetupShown = sliderEarthMiles >= distanceSetupMiles;
      milestoneShown = sliderEarthMiles >= milestoneMiles;

      renderAtPosition(sliderPosition);

      if (sliderPosition <= 0.001) {
        introElapsed = 0;
        introLastTimestamp = null;
        introActive = true;

        if (storyIntroElement) {
          storyIntroElement.classList.remove('is-leaving');
        }

        journeyCaptionState.key = null;
        hideJourneyCaption();
      } else {
        introActive = false;

        if (storyIntroElement) {
          storyIntroElement.classList.add('is-leaving');
        }
      }
    }
  );

  // Use the original, proven autoplay entry point.
  // The opening hold is now handled inside drawFrame(), so autoplay and
